name: Tracking Beacon
body:
Price 1,000 gp; Slot —; CL 5th; Weight —; Aura faint divination

DESCRIPTION

The creator can use locate object upon any device with this enhancement for 5 minutes per day; this duration need not be continuous but must be used in 1-minute increments.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Cost 500 gp; Spells bestow curse, locate object
